name: RUNECLAW
description: Simulation-first AI trading agent with a fail-closed pre-trade risk gate, a chat that reads your account through permission-gated read-only tools before it answers, hashed and verifiable decision records, a paper-trading Arena, and per-user live trading on the operator's say-so. Bitget-native; adapters for seven more venues.
author: Humanoid Traders

safety.human_in_the_loop_note: True as shipped: .env.example sets AUTO_CONFIRM_LIVE_ENABLED=false and AUTO_CONFIRM_THRESHOLD=1.0. An operator may enable auto-confirm, and the code default with no .env file has it ON. Read this field as the shipped posture, not an unconditional guarantee.

hackathon.name: Bitget AI Base Camp S1
hackathon.note: Where the project started. The card describes the product as it ships today, not the submission.

requires_confirmation_note: True as shipped: .env.example sets AUTO_CONFIRM_LIVE_ENABLED=false and AUTO_CONFIRM_THRESHOLD=1.0. An operator may enable auto-confirm, and the code default with no .env file has it ON. Read this field as the shipped posture, not an unconditional guarantee.
exchanges_note: Adapters, not equals: native stop orders and the withdrawal-scope probe exist for Bitget only (bot/core/venues.py).
interfaces_note: web: the app/ platform (dashboard, chat, Arena, Guardian) at the site origin; rest: api_bridge.py; mcp: bot/mcp/server.py and app/routes/mcp.js.

languages.note: Interface languages from app/public/js/i18n.js; chat languages from bot/utils/i18n.py.
